studies.title: The giraffe
studies.caption: A giraffe reaches foliage above the browsing height of most animals. Far from Africa, its height and patterned coat made it an extraordinary diplomatic gift.
studies.prompt: Low-angle full-body giraffe browsing acacia foliage on East African savanna, long neck and forelegs, two short skin-covered ossicones, irregular tawny patches, long dark tongue touching leaves. Four sound legs grounded, full head visible, no leopard hybrid or humans.
